verdict.rationale: Pylon's own agents clearly run standalone inside Pylon's helpdesk, where they can be assigned to issues. The only documented Salesforce link is a daily one-way push of AI conversation summaries to Salesforce accounts, plus account mapping. Nothing shows the agent embedding in Zendesk, Salesforce Service, or Intercom, or syncing tickets two-way with them. Missing for 10: running inside Zendesk/Intercom/Salesforce helpdesks, bidirectional ticket and context sync with external helpdesks, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the agent runs inside my existing helpdesk — Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom — or standalone, syncing tickets and context both ways

citations.quote: You can also assign an individual issue to your AI agent, the same way you might normally assign an issue to a team member.
For every conversation, we use AI to summarize the details, and sync the summary to the relevant Account in Salesforce.
The account mapper now lets you link a CRM account to multiple Pylon accounts
